description: This file defines effects handling and higher-order operators for PyTorch, including effect registration, effectful operator wrappers, and effect token management within the torch._higher_order_ops.effects module.

classes.name: WithEffects
classes.description: A higher-order operator class that manages effect tokens and enforces ordering of side-effectful operations in PyTorch's effect system.

methods.name: _get_op_qualname
methods.description: Converts an operator identifier to a qualified string key.

methods.name: _register_effectful_op
methods.description: Registers an effectful operator with a specified effect type.

methods.name: _get_effect
methods.description: Retrieves the effect associated with an operator.

methods.name: has_aliasing
methods.description: Checks if an operator has aliasing arguments or return values.

methods.name: has_effects
methods.description: Determines if an operator has associated effects and no aliasing.

methods.name: new_token_tensor
methods.description: Creates a new dummy effect token tensor.

methods.name: with_effects_dense
methods.description: Applies effectful operations in dense mode, managing effect tokens.

methods.name: with_effects_proxy
methods.description: Applies effectful operations in ProxyTorchDispatchMode, managing proxy effects.

methods.name: handle_effects
methods.description: Main function to handle effect tokens and effectful operator execution, managing token discovery and effect propagation.
